name: GitLab work item refiner
description: Refine labelled GitLab issues by posting open questions, recommendations, and gaps in the requirements.

gitlab.message: Requires a connected GitLab account or GITLAB_TOKEN with api scope to read issues and post notes. MCP-only access is not supported.

exampleImplementation: Poll open, labelled GitLab issue-type work items. Read the description and human discussion and post one refinement note per label application with open questions, recommendations, and gaps.

schedule.label: Check frequency
schedule.help: How often to check for labelled GitLab issues.

projects.label: Projects
projects.help: GitLab projects whose issues need refinement. Subgroups are supported.

triggerLabel.label: Trigger label
triggerLabel.help: Apply this label to an open issue to request refinement.

gitlabApiUrl.label: GitLab API URL
gitlabApiUrl.help: HTTPS /api/v4 root of the instance. Requires a connected GitLab account or GITLAB_TOKEN; MCP-only access is not supported.

setup.message: This deployment cannot run the bundled refiner directly. Configure a scheduled poll of the selected GitLab projects and label, then create the automation.
